svg.title: SEM · 잔차 공분산6개 포함
svg.desc: 구조 경로와 측정·잔차 모형을 함께 읽는다 75 countries, 11 indicators, 3 latent variables. Structural path CIs are normal expected-Fisher intervals. Good fit is not causal identification.
svg.text: B unstandardized · first loadings fixed at 1
Dashed: residual covariance · ε: indicator error
